title: Afterimage reveal
description: A monochrome textile develops its original color under a soft brush, then slowly returns to grey.
useCase: Reveal a second material or image through a persistent, fading pointer trail.
interaction: Paint across the textile or develop all its color.
reducedMotion: The brush is disabled; the Develop color control reveals the complete image instantly.
limitations: One same-size image is used for both layers. The fading mask resets when the container resizes.
look: Full-bleed damask textile of turquoise oak leaves and flowers on olive silk, an italic cream serif title, small caption and a dark teal rectangular button.
motion: Moving the pointer stamps soft circles into a mask that reveals colour over the greyscale textile, fading back with a 620 ms time constant; a button shows full colour instantly.
adapt: `stamp` paints radial gradients into the offscreen `mask` (radius `w * 0.105`), `tick` fades it each frame via `destination-out` with time constant `620`, and `draw` composites colour over a `grayscale(1) contrast(1.1)` base. Swap `oak-damask.webp` in `photo.src`; keep the resize handling.
